manage_subjects_hint: Add a subject, or rename an existing one. Questions and exams are grouped by subject.

ai_error_choose_subject: Choose a subject — questions are generated for it, not in the abstract.
ai_error_pick_type: Pick at least one question type.
ai_toast_generated: {count, plural, one {# draft} other {# drafts}} ready for your review
ai_toast_approved_exam: Approved and added to the exam
ai_subject_hint: Questions are generated for this subject's syllabus.
ai_how_many_hint: Split across the types you pick.
ai_syllabus_hint: Pasted here, the questions are drawn from this rather than from general knowledge.
ai_additional_placeholder: Avoid questions that need a calculator. Keep options under 12 words.
ai_approve_selected_exam: {count, plural, =0 {Approve into exam} other {Approve # into exam}}
ai_approve_selected_bank: {count, plural, =0 {Approve into bank} other {Approve # into bank}}
ai_no_drafts_body: Generated questions land here first. Nothing reaches an exam until you approve it.
ai_duplicate_warning: Looks like a question already in the bank: “{text}”
ai_not_grounded: Not drawn from your uploaded material — this came from the offline generator, so check it against the syllabus yourself.
ai_feedback_hint: Sent to the model and kept on the record.
ai_feedback_placeholder: Too easy, and option C repeats option A.
ai_options_tap_letter: Options — tap a letter to set the correct answer
editor_translate_stub_notice: No translation model is configured, so this only copied the English text — edit each field by hand before saving.
editor_translate_done_notice: Generated. Review and edit before saving — nothing is saved yet.
editor_translate_error: Could not generate translations. Try again.
editor_problem_body: Write the question, or attach a figure.
editor_problem_one_correct: Only one option may be correct.
editor_problem_model_answer: A written question needs a model answer to grade against.
editor_problem_accepted: List at least one accepted answer.
editor_problem_language: Pick at least one programming language.
editor_problem_marks: Marks must be greater than zero.
editor_problem_word_bounds: The minimum word count is above the maximum.
editor_toast_added_exam_and_bank: Added to the exam and saved to your bank
editor_no_subjects_body: Every question belongs to a subject. Add one before writing questions.
editor_category_hint: The bank shelf. Corporate sections select on this.
editor_topic_hint: e.g. Neural Networks, Percentages, Blood Relations.
editor_tags_hint: Used for searching the bank and for blueprint rules.
editor_body_optional_hint: Optional when the figure carries the question.
editor_passage_intro_placeholder: A heading for the passage. The passage text itself goes below.
editor_body_placeholder: Write the question exactly as the candidate should read it.
editor_checking_duplicate: Checking the bank for a similar question…
editor_duplicate_warning: This looks like a question already in the bank: <q>“{text}”</q>. Saving is still fine if this one is meant to be different.
editor_figure_hint: Optional. Shown above the question during the exam.
editor_tolerance_hint: Plus or minus. An answer this far out still scores.
editor_unit_hint: Shown to the candidate, never marked.
editor_accepted_hint: One per line. Any of them scores full marks.
editor_languages_hint: What the candidate may answer in.
editor_test_cases_hint: — the first pair is shown to the candidate as the worked example
editor_passage_text_hint: Shown above every question attached to this passage.
editor_examiner_only_note: Examiner-only. None of this reaches the candidate during the exam — it is what the grader scores against and what you read while reviewing.
editor_key_points_hint: One per line. The grader reports which were hit.
editor_key_points_placeholder:
Defines the term
Gives an example
States a limitation
editor_marking_scheme_hint: Free text. How marks are apportioned.
editor_marking_scheme_placeholder: 2 marks for the definition, 2 for a worked example, 1 for the caveat.
editor_min_words_hint: Shown to the candidate; never blocks a save.
editor_max_words_hint: Enforced — a longer answer is refused.
editor_explanation_hint: Optional. Released with the result, never during the exam.
editor_save_to_bank_hint_off: This exam only — it will not appear in the bank.
editor_marked_correct: Marked correct: {letters}. Stored on the server and never sent to a candidate's browser.
editor_nothing_marked: Nothing marked correct yet — the question cannot be saved until you choose.
editor_translations_hint: English above is the master version. Check a language to add or edit its text.
editor_translations_save_first: Save the question first, then generate translations.
editor_translation_fallback: Leave blank to fall back to English
